name: Mark Kramer
bio: With over 35 years in the security industry, Mark founded Mantis Security with a vision to deliver integrated, technology-driven protection. His leadership has built the company into one of South Africa's most trusted security providers.

name: Eyal Ben-Shir
bio: Eyal brings international expertise in security talent development. He leads Mantis's recruitment and training programs, ensuring every officer meets the highest standards of professionalism and capability.

name: James Molefe
bio: James oversees all day-to-day security operations, managing deployments across industries. His operational expertise ensures seamless service delivery for every client.

name: Nomsa Dlamini
bio: Nomsa leads Mantis's electronic security and technology division, implementing cutting-edge surveillance, access control, and monitoring solutions for clients nationwide.
